trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (mean on pool3) and the verdict is 'indistinguishable' — the runner-up is not statistically better. action_args.justification: The series has strong trend and seasonality but its spectrum is near white noise, making most variation unpredictable. Model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.029) and errors are highly correlated (mean 0.905, only 2 independent groups), so no subset or fitted weighting can reliably exploit differences. A robust mean over the 9 most stable models (pool3) is the appropriate combination: it hedges across the correlated-error groups without chasing window-specific noise. The leader is a seed with an 'indistinguishable' margin over the runner-up, confirming no strategy in the history is statistically superior.
